landing.hero.headline: Remove image backgrounds without uploading a single pixel.
landing.hero.subheadline: A free, unlimited background remover that runs an AI model on your own device. No account, no watermark, no file limits — and your photos never leave your computer.
landing.hero.note: Works offline once the model is cached · PNG with transparency · HD output
landing.features.title: Everything remove.bg did, minus the upload
landing.features.description: The model runs inside your browser with WebGPU. Your images stay in memory on your device from start to finish.
landing.features.private.title: Private by design
landing.features.private.description: Images are processed in a Web Worker on your machine. There is no upload endpoint to leak from — check the Network tab yourself.
landing.features.free.title: Free and unlimited
landing.features.free.description: No credits, no daily quota, no watermark, no signup. Process as many images as your device can handle.
landing.features.fast.title: GPU accelerated
landing.features.fast.description: WebGPU inference finishes most photos in under a second on a modern laptop, with an automatic CPU fallback everywhere else.
landing.features.quality.title: Clean edges, real hair
landing.features.quality.description: Powered by BEN2 and BiRefNet, open matting models that handle hair, fur, glass and fine detail far better than classic segmenters.
landing.features.offline.title: Works offline
landing.features.offline.description: The model downloads once and is cached by your browser. After that you can pull the plug and keep working.
landing.features.open.title: Open models, honest licenses
landing.features.open.description: Built only on MIT-licensed models so the tool can stay free forever, with attribution to the researchers who made it possible.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.description: Short answers about privacy, quality and how this stays free.
landing.faq.upload.question: Is my image really not uploaded anywhere?
landing.faq.upload.answer: Correct. The AI model is downloaded to your browser and runs locally in a Web Worker. Your image bytes never leave your device. You can verify this by opening DevTools → Network while processing, or by disconnecting from the internet after the model has loaded.
landing.faq.download.question: Why is there a large one-time download?
landing.faq.download.answer: The neural network weights (roughly 100–220 MB depending on the model) have to live on your device for the processing to be local. Your browser caches them, so the download only happens once per device.
landing.faq.quality.question: How does the quality compare to remove.bg?
landing.faq.quality.answer: For people, products and animals the results are on par for most photos, including hair and fur. Extremely fine or translucent details can still differ. The Quality mode runs a second refinement pass on the subject for sharper edges.
landing.faq.browser.question: Which browsers and devices work?
landing.faq.browser.answer: Any modern browser works. Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers on desktop use WebGPU for the fastest results. Safari, Firefox and phones fall back to a CPU path and a lighter model, which is slower but still fully local.
landing.faq.free.question: How can this be free?
landing.faq.free.answer: Because your device does the work, we have no per-image server costs. The site is static and cheap to host. It may show unobtrusive ads or a donation link in the future, but the tool itself will stay free and unlimited.
landing.cta.headline: remove.bg is closing. Your photos don't need to move to the cloud.
landing.cta.subheadline: Drop an image and get a transparent PNG in seconds, processed entirely on your device.
